title: E40-m4 shipping-operator counterfactual re-analysis

operator_counterfactual.name: F2_ship = cycle argmax of cycle-visible proxy

statistics.perm: exhaustive sign-flip, 2^12, p = #{T_perm >= T_obs}/4096, T = mean(diffs)
statistics.CT1_primary: d = f0_best - f2_ship, raw wasserstein (negative = F0 better)
statistics.CT2_recovery: d = f2_final - f2_ship (negative = proxy shipping improves)
statistics.M1_mechanism: per-chain Spearman(proxy, raw primary) over 4 cycles; pooled Fisher-z; within-chain cycle-shuffle two-sided p, seed 20260831, 10000 draws
statistics.M2_selection_census: true-rank of proxy-chosen cycle; cycle1-persistence count

routing_preregistered.G1_and_not_G2: draft m5 prospective interventional: shipping rule = proxy-argmax, matched scale, m-series gates
routing_preregistered.G2_and_not_G1: draft m5-prime feedback-channel design (calibrated extreme-resident probes / proxy-truth calibration)
routing_preregistered.neither: E40 line stays terminal-negative pending a new mechanism class; neither named lever authorized

controls.C2_leakage: FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS absent from every redacted_feedback.json read

custody.input_manifest: sha256 of every file read + script self-sha
custody.determinism: byte-identical JSON on re-run; only RNG is the frozen-seed M1 shuffle

no_rescue_clause: m4 attributes and selects levers only; no positive F2/component claim; every revival requires a prospective m5/m5-prime execution under its own freeze
